websiteHeroSubtitle: Klartxt analyses four aspects of a website's privacy behaviour. Here is what each one means and why it matters.
websiteHeroImageAlt: Laptop mockup showing the Klartxt browser extension in use
websiteVideoCaption: Video: Klartxt Privacy Explained, generated with NotebookLM (Gemini), Google LLC, 14 June 2026.
website_tracker_subtitle: Scripts that monitor your behavior across the web
website_tracker_s1_body: Trackers are small scripts or invisible pixels embedded in websites. They silently record which pages you visit, how long you stay, what you click, and even your approximate location, often without you ever noticing.
website_tracker_s2_body: Klartxt intercepts all outgoing network requests made by your browser when loading a page. Each request is checked against the DuckDuckGo Tracker Radar database (DuckDuckGo, Inc., 2025), one of the most comprehensive and regularly updated tracker lists available.
website_tracker_s3_body: Trackers from advertising networks build detailed profiles about you over time. This data is bought and sold between companies, used to target you with ads, and can be accessed by governments in some jurisdictions.
website_tracker_cat_ads_desc: Display targeted ads based on your browsing and click behaviour.
website_tracker_cat_tracking_desc: Measure page views, clicks and mouse movements -> sometimes recording your entire session.
website_tracker_cat_content_desc: External content such as embedded videos, maps or social media buttons.
website_tracker_cat_security_desc: Protection mechanisms against fraud and abuse -> typically not active tracking.
website_tracker_cat_functional_desc: Essential services such as login, payment processing or support chat.
website_cookies_subtitle: Small files that websites store in your browser
website_cookies_s1_body: Cookies are tiny text files that a website saves to your browser. They can be useful, for example, keeping you logged in or remembering your shopping cart. But they are also frequently used for tracking.
website_cookies_s2_body: First-party cookies are set by the website you are visiting. Third-party cookies are set by external services embedded on the page. They are the primary tool for cross-site tracking.
website_cookies_s3_body: Klartxt logs all cookies set during your visit, identifies their origin, and checks whether any were set before you gave consent, a technical finding that may indicate a potential violation of GDPR Article 7.
website_cookies_cat_tracking_desc: Track your behaviour across websites and are used for profiling and targeted advertising.
website_cookies_cat_functional_desc: Store preferences like language or login state -> useful but not strictly required.
website_cookies_cat_necessary_desc: Technically required to operate the site, such as session cookies or security tokens.
website_privacyPolicy_subtitle: The legal document that explains how your data is used
website_privacyPolicy_s1_body: A privacy policy is a document in which a website explains what personal data it collects, why, how it is stored, and who it is shared with. Under GDPR, this document must be clearly accessible.
website_privacyPolicy_s2_body: GDPR Articles 13 and 14 require websites to proactively inform users about data processing before or at the time of collection. A missing or hard-to-find privacy policy may indicate a potential failure to meet this obligation.
website_privacyPolicy_s3_body: Klartxt searches the page for common privacy policy patterns in the footer, navigation, and linked documents. If no findable link is detected, this is a technical finding that may indicate a potential transparency issue.
website_thirdParty_subtitle: External services contacted when a page loads
website_thirdParty_s1_body: Every time you load a page, your browser may contact dozens of external servers, for fonts, analytics, ads, social media buttons, or payment providers. Each of these is a third-party request.
website_thirdParty_s2_body: Each third-party request reveals your IP address, browser details, and the page you are visiting to an external company. Even if you never interact with an element, the request has already been sent.
website_thirdParty_s3_body: Klartxt counts all network requests that go to a domain different from the site you are visiting. A high number means a larger surface area for data exposure, regardless of whether those services are classified as trackers.
privacyPage_overview_body: Klartxt is a browser extension that analyzes specific tracking mechanisms (network requests and cookies) on a website in real time and visualizes them in a structured way. It checks for compliance with the European data protection regulations, identifies data flows, and provides well-founded recommendations for action based on technical analysis.
privacyPage_dataCollection_body: Klartxt does not collect, transmit, sell, or share any personal data. No user data is sent to external servers.
privacyPage_localProcessing_body: All analysis is performed locally within the browser. Detected information (such as trackers, scripts, or URLs) is stored temporarily in session storage and is automatically cleared when the browser tab is closed.
privacyPage_permissions_intro: The extension requires certain browser permissions solely to detect tracking mechanisms:
privacyPage_permissions_network: Network requests are analyzed to identify tracking behavior
privacyPage_permissions_tabs: Tabs are used to associate detected trackers with the correct browser tab
privacyPage_permissions_storage: Storage is used for temporary, session-based data storage
privacyPage_permissions_cookies: Cookies may be inspected for tracking-related purposes only
privacyPage_permissions_sidepanel: Sidepanel is used to display tracking information alongside the current page
privacyPage_permissions_outro: These permissions are not used to monitor user activity or browsing behavior.
privacyPage_noThirdParty_analytics: Klartxt does not use analytics services
privacyPage_noThirdParty_remoteCode: Klartxt does not load remote code
privacyPage_changes_body: If this privacy policy changes, updates will be published in this repository.
imprintPage_disclaimer_body: Klartxt is a browser extension developed as part of an academic project. It is provided as-is without any warranty. The analysis results are based on technical detection and do not constitute legal advice.
imprintPage_project_body: Klartxt was developed as a Bachelor Major Project at SAE Institute Switzerland. The extension is open source and intended for educational and research purposes.
sourcesPage_intro: All sources used in the development of the extension and website are listed below.
